data.body: Implemented F19C in docs/config.md only. Corrected cross-ticket overlap to ADR 0086 and the transport retry label to ADR 0087. Rewrote REBAR_OPERATION_SNAPSHOT_SHADOW guidance to document the active temporary diagnostic-only switch, enabled default and recognized spellings, unrecognized-value fallback, catch-all diagnostic Exception handling including ConfigError and InsecureUrlError, fail-fast normal composer behavior, and retirement by a future behavior-bearing cutover. Verification passed with python scripts/check_docs_index.py --check, python scripts/gen_config_reference.py --check, and git diff --check origin/main. git diff --name-status origin/main reports only M docs/config.md.
